summary: The fundus seen through the pupil with a fundus lens (90D): the orange-red background behind the disc, vessels and macula.

background_colour.note: Linear reflectance of the mid-peripheral fundus; sRGB #ab3322. sRGB sampled from the user's wide-field fundus reference (not in the repo), converted to linear; render calibration.

peripheral_darkening.note: Fraction of linear reflectance lost toward the edge of the field (the reference: 0.18 against 0.42 in red); render calibration.

tessellation.note: How visible the choroidal vessels are through the thinning RPE: more with age and in myopia; render calibration (low).

nerve_fibre_sheen.note: Strength of the striated reflex of the retinal nerve-fibre layer along the arcades; fades with age, and is lost in a glaucomatous nerve-fibre defect; render calibration (low).

clinical.notes: Fundus coordinates: millimetres on the retina from the foveal centre, +x temporal, +y up, the same for both eyes (the renderer mirrors the left eye).

provenance.source: Colours from the user's fundus reference (render calibration); age trends from Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed.
